changelog: Codex Home Git Hub: Integrated branch switcher, owner/repo slug, uncommitted file counts with +lines/-lines stats, inline diff viewer, commit/push/pull/discard actions, and agent diff review into the Home workspace card
Turn & Session Code Impact Tracking: Persistent +additions/-deletions counters per assistant response and on Home recent conversation cards
Codex Prompt Dot-Slider: Edge vertical prompt navigation rail with tactile thumb gliding, tap-to-scroll, and live preview tooltips across multi-turn chats
Response Telemetry Pill & Full-Chat Dialog: Added response timestamps, turn code deltas, interactive breakdown modal for per-response & cumulative chat usage, and summary copy

Usage Credit & Quota Accuracy Fixes: Corrected Antigravity and Claude credit remaining calculations, fixed float truncation and null 0% badges, merged per-model quota limits with 5h/7d buckets, and enabled automatic post-turn refreshes
IDE File Citation Pills & Storage Manager: Clean vector filetype citation pills without emoji artifacts, plus per-category app storage breakdown and cache cleanup panel
